Achref Abada.note: Abada's edge is staying ready through long quiet spells. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Achref Abada.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Adil Boulbina.note: Boulbina is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Adil Boulbina.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Aissa Mandi.note: Watch Mandi for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Aissa Mandi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Amine Gouiri.note: Gouiri's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Amine Gouiri.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Anis Hadj Moussa.note: Moussa is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Anis Hadj Moussa.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Fares Chaibi.note: Chaïbi stands out for repeatable technique on dead balls. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Fares Chaibi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是定位球上稳定而多变的脚法。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Fares Ghedjemis.note: Ghedjemis's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Fares Ghedjemis.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Hicham Boudaoui.note: Boudaoui stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Hicham Boudaoui.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Houssem Aouar.note: Aouar's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Houssem Aouar.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ibrahim Maza.note: Maza is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Ibrahim Maza.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Jaouen Hadjam.note: Hadjam's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Jaouen Hadjam.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Luca Zidane.note: Watch Zidane for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Luca Zidane.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Melvin Mastil.note: Mastil is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Melvin Mastil.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Mohamed Amine Tougai.note: Watch Tougai for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Mohamed Amine Tougai.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Mohamed Amoura.note: Watch Amoura for explosive speed once open grass appears. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Mohamed Amoura.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Nabil Bentaleb.note: Bentaleb stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Nabil Bentaleb.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Nadhir Benbouali.note: Benbouali stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Nadhir Benbouali.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Oussama Benbot.note: Benbot is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Oussama Benbot.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Rak Belghali.note: Belghali is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Rak Belghali.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Ramy Bensebaini.note: Bensebaini's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Ramy Bensebaini.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Ramiz Zerrouki.note: Zerrouki's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Ramiz Zerrouki.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Rayan Ait-Nouri.note: Aït-Nouri's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Rayan Ait-Nouri.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Riyad Mahrez.note: Mahrez stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Riyad Mahrez.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Samir Chergui.note: Chergui is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Samir Chergui.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Yassine Titraoui.note: Watch Titraoui for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Yassine Titraoui.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Zineddine Belaid.note: Belaïd's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Zineddine Belaid.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。
